🎥🎬: Xena: Warrior Princess (1995–2001)

Xena, once a ruthless warrior feared across ancient Greece, turns her back on her violent past and sets out to atone for the lives she destroyed. Armed with her legendary chakram and unmatched fighting skills, she travels from one land to another helping people in danger and standing against warlords, monsters, and gods.

Along the way, Xena is joined by Gabrielle, an ambitious young woman who becomes her closest friend and companion. Together, they face countless battles and supernatural threats while Xena struggles with the darkness of her past and her determination to become a better person.

source_details.synopsis: Xena: Warrior Princess is an American sword-and-sorcery television series filmed in New Zealand, which aired in first-run syndication from September 4, 1995, to June 18, 2001. Critics have praised the series for its strong female protagonist, and it has acquired a strong cult following, attention in fandom, parody, and academia, and has influenced the direction of other television series. Writer-director-producer Robert Tapert created the series in 1995 under his production tag, Renaissance Pictures, with executive producers R. J.
